subject: Discovery recap & next steps — PayBridge integration
messages:
From: Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.ai>
To: Elena Morales <elena@paybridge.com>, PayBridge Procurement <procurement@paybridge.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 28 Aug 2025 09:15:00 -0700
Subject: Discovery recap & proposed mutual action plan (PayBridge)

Hi Elena — thanks again for the call this morning. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we keep momentum heading into the quarter close:

- Goal: Reduce inference unit cost for real-time payments fraud scoring while keeping median latency <120ms (target).
- Today: PayBridge runs model offline; want a hosted inference option for production traffic and predictable cost.
- Primary success metrics: 30% token-cost reduction, <120ms p95, and SOC2 controls in place for sensitive PII traffic.

Proposed next steps:
1) Share Redwood TCO one‑pager and a short MAP (attached) — done.
2) 30‑min technical deep dive with Julio Ramos (VP Eng) + security on Mon/Tue next week — can you confirm availability?
3) Ballpark pricing and pilot proposal (I attached a one‑pager + MAP). If budget approval is required this quarter, please let us know the approver and timeline so we can prioritize.

Attachments: redwood-tco-one-pager.pdf; paybridge-mutual-action-plan.xlsx

If it's helpful I can also freeze a pilot slot and lock Q3 pricing for 30 days while you run internal approvals. Would you like me to do that?

Thanks — I’ll follow up if I don’t hear back in a couple days.

Best,
Irene Choi
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
irene_choi@redwood.ai
Phone: (415) 555-0198

--

Thanks, Irene — helpful recap and the MAP looks good. A few quick notes:

- Julio (VP Eng) is the technical decision owner; I’ve looped procurement for budget/contract questions.
- We have an internal budget review scheduled for 9/2 but there’s some chance it shifts to the following week depending on other priorities.
- Could you send a short ballpark pricing range (pilot vs. production) and any quick SOC2 / security artifacts we can share with security?

If you can lock a pricing window for September that would help — otherwise we’ll risk getting priced into Q4 approvals.

Appreciate it — Elena

Procurement asked if you can provide:
- SOC2 Type II report or a timeline for when Redwood can provide relevant artifacts
- Data retention and deletion policy summary
- A sample DPA (if available)

If you can share those items, we’ll keep your slot in the queue for the 9/2 review. If not, procurement may need to move the decision to the following week. Also — we’d like to confirm whether Redwood can hold the pilot pricing for 30 days if approval slips.

Thanks,

Thanks for the update, Elena — totally understand. We can absolutely support the security handoff and preserve pricing while you complete your review. Next steps I propose:

1) Security packet: I’ll share our SOC2 summary, retention policy snippet, and a sample DPA by end of day tomorrow. If procurement needs the full report we can coordinate an NDA path; let me know which they prefer.
2) Quick alignment call: 20 minutes with Julio + security (I’m available Tue/Wed 9/2–9/3 at 10:00–11:30 PT) — pick a slot and I’ll send calendar invite.
3) Pricing hold: We’ll lock the pilot pricing for 30 days from the date you confirm in writing — I’ll mark that in the HubSpot deal record.

If you prefer to pause until the security review finishes, tell me and I’ll pause outreach. Otherwise I’ll proceed to send the security packet and lock the pricing window.

Would you like me to proceed with the packet and tentatively hold 9/2 at 10:00 PT?

Best,
